From bae69bfa3a586493469078ec4ca35499b754ba5c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kevin Hilman <khilman@baylibre.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2020 11:09:30 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] clk: meson: Kconfig: fix dependency for G12A

When building only G12A, ensure that VID_PLL_DIV clock driver is
selected, otherwise results in this build error:

ERROR: modpost: "meson_vid_pll_div_ro_ops" [drivers/clk/meson/g12a.ko] undefined!

Fixes: 085a4ea93d54 ("clk: meson: g12a: add peripheral clock controller")
Signed-off-by: Kevin Hilman <khilman@baylibre.com>
Signed-off-by: Jerome Brunet <jbrunet@baylibre.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20201118190930.34352-1-khilman@baylibre.com

diff --git a/drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig b/drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig
index 034da203e8e0..9a8a548d839d 100644
--- a/drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig
@@ -110,6 +110,7 @@ config COMMON_CLK_G12A
 	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_AO_CLKC
 	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_EE_CLKC
 	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_CPU_DYNDIV
+	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV
 	select MFD_SYSCON
 	help
 	  Support for the clock controller on Amlogic S905D2, S905X2 and S905Y2
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig`**
   - A new line was added to the configuration for `COMMON_CLK_G12A`:
     ```plaintext
     + select COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV
     ```
   - This modification ensures that the `VID_PLL_DIV` clock driver is selected when building for the G12A, addressing a build error related to an undefined symbol.

### Relationships

- The modification in the `Kconfig` file is directly related to a build issue that occurs when the G12A is built without the `VID_PLL_DIV` clock driver being selected. The patch fixes this by explicitly selecting the necessary driver, thereby preventing the undefined symbol error during the build process. This change is a corrective measure for the previously introduced functionality in commit `085a4ea93d54`, which added the peripheral clock controller for G12A.

clk: meson: Kconfig: fix dependency for G12A

Fixes: 085a4ea93d54 ("clk: meson: g12a: add peripheral clock controller")
Signed-off-by: Kevin Hilman <khilman@baylibre.com>
Signed-off-by: Jerome Brunet <jbrunet@baylibre.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20201118190930.34352-1-khilman@baylibre.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the absence of the `VID_PLL_DIV` clock driver selection in the Kconfig for the G12A configuration, which led to an undefined symbol error during the build process when the G12A was being compiled without this driver being included.

Reason:
The absence of the `select COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV` statement in the Kconfig for the G12A configuration means that the VID_PLL_DIV clock driver is not included in the build. This results in the undefined symbol error for `meson_vid_pll_div_ro_ops` when the G12A is compiled, as the necessary clock driver is not available.
